157. Agency for collection.— The tax, rate, fee or other amount payable to the 
Panchayat may be collected by such agency as the Panchayat may appoint in this behalf, 
provided that it shall be lawful for a Panchayat to lease the right to collect any tax, rates, 
fees or other amount that may be imposed under this Act, by public auction or by tender, 
subject to the rules prescribed and the amount due under such lease shall be recoverable 
in the manner provided in this Chapter.
